newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanian rights groups urge protection of press.
newsitem.headline: Albanian rights groups urge protection of press.

text.p: Albanian human rights groups called on Tuesday for the urgent protection of local journalists after a newspaper reported that death lists were circulating naming a number of them.

A statement from the Albanian Human Rights Group and local journalists' organisations also called for an amnesty announced at the weekend for rebels who have seized most of the south to include politicians and journalists.

On Monday the government newspaper Rilindja Demokratike reported that lists emanating from rebels in the south, one signed by a so-called Salvation Committee for South Albania, had threatened the lives of a number of prominent journalists.

The statement from the rights groups said the lists included pro-government and opposition journalists threatened "for having vigorously supported the different sides in the highly charged political debate of recent weeks".

"While recognising that the press of all sides has at times played an ignoble role, the groups nevertheless believe that all journalists should have their physical safety assured", the statement added.
